title: Width a little short
text: Width a little short. For some reason the cubical walls in my office are extremely wide, like four inches or more. :/  This item works with that configuration, but it is too narrow, looks a bit off when installed, and a lot of times the hook comes off when I remove my coat.  No problem to just put it back on, but I would have preferred something that fit better.  It does work, however, and I've had many of my office mates ask me about where I purchased it. :)
